FAN-RUNTIME-HOURS.sql:
WITH ordered AS (
  SELECT
    equipment_id,
    timestamp_utc,
    fan_cmd AS fan_cmd,
    ((
      LEAD(timestamp_utc) OVER (PARTITION BY equipment_id ORDER BY timestamp_utc)
      - timestamp_utc
    )) AS dt_seconds
  FROM history
),
held AS (
  SELECT
    equipment_id,
    fan_cmd,
    CASE
      WHEN dt_seconds IS NULL OR dt_seconds <= 0.0 OR dt_seconds > (1 * 3600.0)
      THEN 0.0
      ELSE dt_seconds
    END AS held_seconds
  FROM ordered
)
SELECT
  equipment_id,
  SUM(CASE WHEN fan_cmd > 0.05 THEN held_seconds ELSE 0.0 END) / 3600.0 AS fan_runtime_hours,
  SUM(CASE WHEN fan_cmd IS NOT NULL THEN held_seconds ELSE 0.0 END) / 3600.0 AS total_hours
FROM held
GROUP BY equipment_id;

WITH h AS (
  SELECT
    equipment_id,
    timestamp_utc,
    zone_t,
    occ_mode,
    CAST(round(CASE WHEN zone_t < 21.111111111 OR zone_t > 23.888888889 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS INTEGER) AS band_fault
  FROM history
  WHERE zone_t IS NOT NULL
),
base AS (
  SELECT
    equipment_id,
    timestamp_utc,
    CAST(round(CASE
      WHEN 1 >= 0.5
       AND occ_mode IS NOT NULL
       AND (
         LOWER(trim(CAST(occ_mode AS TEXT))) IN
           ('unoccupied','unocc','off','false','night','standby','setback','no')
         OR (
           fdd_try_double(trim(CAST(occ_mode AS TEXT))) IS NOT NULL
           AND fdd_try_double(trim(CAST(occ_mode AS TEXT))) <= 0.05
         )
       )
      THEN 0
      ELSE band_fault
    END) AS INTEGER) AS raw_fault
  FROM h
),
elapsed_hold AS (
  SELECT
    stepped.*,
    CASE
      WHEN stepped.dt_seconds IS NULL
        OR stepped.dt_seconds <= 0.0
        OR stepped.dt_seconds > (1 * 3600.0)
      THEN 0.0
      ELSE stepped.dt_seconds
    END AS held_seconds,
    CASE
      WHEN stepped.dt_seconds > (1 * 3600.0) THEN 1
      ELSE 0
    END AS gap_after
  FROM (
    SELECT
      src.*,
      ((
        LEAD(src.timestamp_utc) OVER (
          PARTITION BY src.equipment_id ORDER BY src.timestamp_utc
        ) - src.timestamp_utc
      )) AS dt_seconds
    FROM base src
  ) stepped
),
lagged AS (
  SELECT
    *,
    CASE
      WHEN raw_fault = LAG(raw_fault) OVER (PARTITION BY equipment_id ORDER BY timestamp_utc)
       AND COALESCE(LAG(gap_after) OVER (PARTITION BY equipment_id ORDER BY timestamp_utc), 0) = 0
      THEN 0 ELSE 1
    END AS is_new_streak
  FROM elapsed_hold
),
grp AS (
  SELECT
    *,
    SUM(is_new_streak)
      OVER (PARTITION BY equipment_id ORDER BY timestamp_utc ROWS UNBOUNDED PRECEDING) AS streak_id
  FROM lagged
),
ranked AS (
  SELECT
    *,
    SUM(held_seconds) OVER (
      PARTITION BY equipment_id, streak_id ORDER BY timestamp_utc
      ROWS UNBOUNDED PRECEDING
    ) AS streak_elapsed
  FROM grp
),
final AS (
  SELECT
    equipment_id,
    held_seconds,
    timestamp_utc,
    CASE WHEN raw_fault = 1 AND streak_elapsed >= 900 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS confirmed
  FROM ranked
)
SELECT
  equipment_id,
  SUM(CASE WHEN confirmed = 1 THEN held_seconds ELSE 0.0 END) / 3600.0 AS fault_hours,
  SUM(held_seconds) / 3600.0 AS covered_hours,
  100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN confirmed = 1 THEN held_seconds ELSE 0.0 END) / NULLIF(SUM(held_seconds), 0.0) AS fault_pct
FROM final
GROUP BY equipment_id;

WITH web_points AS (
  SELECT timestamp_utc, web_oa_t AS ref_val
  FROM weather
  WHERE web_oa_t IS NOT NULL
  UNION ALL
  SELECT timestamp_utc, web_oa_t AS ref_val
  FROM history
  WHERE web_oa_t IS NOT NULL
),
web_dedup AS (
  SELECT timestamp_utc, MAX(ref_val) AS ref_val
  FROM web_points
  GROUP BY timestamp_utc
),
web_intervals AS (
  SELECT
    timestamp_utc AS ref_ts,
    ref_val,
    LEAD(timestamp_utc) OVER (ORDER BY timestamp_utc) AS next_ref_ts
  FROM web_dedup
),
joined AS (
  SELECT
    h.equipment_id,
    h.timestamp_utc,
    h.oa_t,
    (wi.ref_ts) AS ref_ts,
    CAST(wi.ref_val AS REAL) AS ref_oa_t,
    CASE
      WHEN h.oa_t IS NULL THEN false
      WHEN wi.ref_val IS NULL THEN false
      WHEN ((h.timestamp_utc - wi.ref_ts)) > 1500
      THEN false
      ELSE true
    END AS assessable
  FROM history h
  LEFT JOIN web_intervals wi
    ON h.timestamp_utc >= wi.ref_ts
   AND (wi.next_ref_ts IS NULL OR h.timestamp_utc < wi.next_ref_ts)
),
base AS (
  SELECT
    equipment_id,
    timestamp_utc,
    assessable,
    CAST(round(CASE
      WHEN NOT assessable THEN NULL
      WHEN ABS(oa_t - ref_oa_t) > 2.777778 THEN 1
      ELSE 0 END) AS INTEGER) AS raw_fault
  FROM joined
),
elapsed_hold AS (
  SELECT
    stepped.*,
    CASE
      WHEN NOT assessable THEN 0.0
      WHEN stepped.dt_seconds IS NULL
        OR stepped.dt_seconds <= 0.0
        OR stepped.dt_seconds > (1 * 3600.0)
      THEN 0.0
      ELSE stepped.dt_seconds
    END AS held_seconds,
    CASE
      WHEN stepped.dt_seconds > (1 * 3600.0) THEN 1
      ELSE 0
    END AS gap_after
  FROM (
    SELECT
      src.*,
      ((
        LEAD(src.timestamp_utc) OVER (
          PARTITION BY src.equipment_id ORDER BY src.timestamp_utc
        ) - src.timestamp_utc
      )) AS dt_seconds
    FROM base src
  ) stepped
),
lagged AS (
  SELECT
    *,
    CASE
      WHEN NOT assessable THEN 1
      WHEN raw_fault = LAG(raw_fault) OVER (PARTITION BY equipment_id ORDER BY timestamp_utc)
       AND COALESCE(LAG(gap_after) OVER (PARTITION BY equipment_id ORDER BY timestamp_utc), 0) = 0
       AND COALESCE(LAG(assessable) OVER (PARTITION BY equipment_id ORDER BY timestamp_utc), false)
      THEN 0 ELSE 1
    END AS is_new_streak
  FROM elapsed_hold
),
grp AS (
  SELECT
    *,
    SUM(is_new_streak)
      OVER (PARTITION BY equipment_id ORDER BY timestamp_utc ROWS UNBOUNDED PRECEDING) AS streak_id
  FROM lagged
),
ranked AS (
  SELECT
    *,
    SUM(held_seconds) OVER (
      PARTITION BY equipment_id, streak_id ORDER BY timestamp_utc
      ROWS UNBOUNDED PRECEDING
    ) AS streak_elapsed
  FROM grp
),
final AS (
  SELECT
    equipment_id,
    held_seconds,
    CASE
      WHEN assessable AND raw_fault = 1 AND streak_elapsed >= 900 THEN 1
      ELSE 0
    END AS confirmed
  FROM ranked
)
SELECT
  equipment_id,
  SUM(CASE WHEN confirmed = 1 THEN held_seconds ELSE 0.0 END) / 3600.0 AS fault_hours,
  SUM(held_seconds) / 3600.0 AS covered_hours,
  100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN confirmed = 1 THEN held_seconds ELSE 0.0 END)
    / NULLIF(SUM(held_seconds), 0.0) AS fault_pct
FROM final
GROUP BY equipment_id;

WITH rp AS (
  SELECT equipment_id,
    CASE WHEN 1 >= 0.5 AND COUNT(run_proof) = 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS no_run_proof
  FROM history
  GROUP BY equipment_id
),
h AS (
  SELECT
    run_proof,
    equipment_id,
    timestamp_utc,
    sat,
    sat_sp,
    COALESCE(clg_valve_pct, 0.0) AS clg_valve_pct,
    COALESCE(oa_damper_pct, 0.0) AS oa_damper_pct,
    fan_cmd,
    fan_status,
        CASE
      WHEN fan_status IS NOT NULL THEN CASE WHEN fan_status > 0.05 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END
      WHEN fan_cmd IS NOT NULL THEN CASE WHEN fan_cmd > 0.01 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END
      ELSE 1
    END AS fan_on

  FROM history
),
base AS (
  SELECT
    equipment_id,
    timestamp_utc,
    CAST(round(CASE
      WHEN 1 >= 0.5 AND COALESCE(run_proof, 0) <= 0.05 THEN 0
      WHEN COALESCE(fan_on, 1) = 0 THEN 0
      WHEN COALESCE(mode_stable, 1) = 0 THEN 0
      WHEN sat IS NOT NULL AND sat_sp IS NOT NULL
       AND clg_valve_pct > 0.9
       AND sat > sat_sp + 0.638888889
       AND (oa_damper_pct <= 0.05 OR oa_damper_pct > 0.9)
      THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS INTEGER) AS raw_fault
  FROM (
  SELECT h.*,
    CASE
      WHEN COALESCE(fan_on, 1) = 0 THEN 0

        PARTITION BY equipment_id ORDER BY timestamp_utc

    END AS mode_stable
  FROM h
) h

  SELECT equipment_id,
    CASE WHEN 1 >= 0.5 AND COUNT(run_proof) = 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS no_run_proof
  FROM history
  GROUP BY equipment_id
),
h AS (
  SELECT
    run_proof,
    equipment_id,
    timestamp_utc,
    vav_discharge_t,
    ahu_sat,
    zone_flow,
    fan_cmd,
    fan_status,
    CASE
      WHEN fan_status IS NOT NULL THEN CASE WHEN fan_status > 0.05 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END
      WHEN fan_cmd IS NOT NULL THEN CASE WHEN fan_cmd > 0.01 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END
      ELSE 1
    END AS fan_on
  FROM history
),
base AS (
  SELECT
    equipment_id,
    timestamp_utc,
    CAST(round(CASE
      WHEN 1 >= 0.5 AND COALESCE(run_proof, 0) <= 0.05 THEN 0
      WHEN COALESCE(fan_on, 0) = 0 THEN 0
      WHEN vav_discharge_t IS NULL OR ahu_sat IS NULL THEN 0
      WHEN COALESCE(zone_flow, 0) > 11.798675
       AND ABS(vav_discharge_t - ahu_sat) > 4.444444444 THEN 1
      ELSE 0
    END) AS INTEGER) AS raw_fault
  FROM h
),
elapsed_hold AS (
  SELECT
    stepped.*,
    CASE
      WHEN stepped.dt_seconds IS NULL
        OR stepped.dt_seconds <= 0.0
        OR stepped.dt_seconds > (1 * 3600.0)
      THEN 0.0
      ELSE stepped.dt_seconds
    END AS held_seconds,
    CASE
      WHEN stepped.dt_seconds > (1 * 3600.0) THEN 1
      ELSE 0
    END AS gap_after
  FROM (
    SELECT
      src.*,
      ((
        LEAD(src.timestamp_utc) OVER (
          PARTITION BY src.equipment_id ORDER BY src.timestamp_utc
        ) - src.timestamp_utc
      )) AS dt_seconds
    FROM base src
  ) stepped
),
lagged AS (
  SELECT
    *,
    CASE
      WHEN raw_fault = LAG(raw_fault) OVER (PARTITION BY equipment_id ORDER BY timestamp_utc)
       AND COALESCE(LAG(gap_after) OVER (PARTITION BY equipment_id ORDER BY timestamp_utc), 0) = 0
      THEN 0 ELSE 1
    END AS is_new_streak
  FROM elapsed_hold
),
grp AS (
  SELECT
    *,
    SUM(is_new_streak)
      OVER (PARTITION BY equipment_id ORDER BY timestamp_utc ROWS UNBOUNDED PRECEDING) AS streak_id
  FROM lagged
),
ranked AS (
  SELECT
    *,
    SUM(held_seconds) OVER (
      PARTITION BY equipment_id, streak_id ORDER BY timestamp_utc
      ROWS UNBOUNDED PRECEDING
    ) AS streak_elapsed
  FROM grp
),
final AS (
  SELECT
    equipment_id,
    held_seconds,
    CASE WHEN raw_fault = 1 AND streak_elapsed >= 900 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS confirmed
  FROM ranked
)
SELECT
  equipment_id,
  CASE WHEN (SELECT rpx.no_run_proof FROM rp rpx WHERE rpx.equipment_id = final.equipment_id) = 1 THEN NULL ELSE SUM(CASE WHEN confirmed = 1 THEN held_seconds ELSE 0.0 END) / 3600.0 END AS fault_hours,
  CASE WHEN (SELECT rpx.no_run_proof FROM rp rpx WHERE rpx.equipment_id = final.equipment_id) = 1 THEN 0.0 ELSE SUM(held_seconds) / 3600.0 END AS covered_hours,
  CASE WHEN (SELECT rpx.no_run_proof FROM rp rpx WHERE rpx.equipment_id = final.equipment_id) = 1 THEN NULL ELSE 100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN confirmed = 1 THEN held_seconds ELSE 0.0 END) / NULLIF(SUM(held_seconds), 0.0) END AS fault_pct
FROM final
GROUP BY equipment_id;

    chw_pump_status,

    building_zone_load_satisfied,
    building_ahu_load_satisfied,
    CASE
      WHEN building_zone_load_satisfied IS NOT NULL
        OR building_ahu_load_satisfied IS NOT NULL THEN 1
      ELSE 0
    END AS sat_present,
    COALESCE(building_zone_load_satisfied, building_ahu_load_satisfied) AS load_sat
  FROM history

WITH ordered AS (

    equipment_id,
    cooling_sp,
    heating_sp,

      - timestamp_utc
    )) AS dt_seconds
  FROM history
),
held AS (
  SELECT
    equipment_id,
    cooling_sp,
    heating_sp,
    CASE
      WHEN dt_seconds IS NULL OR dt_seconds <= 0.0 OR dt_seconds > (1 * 3600.0)

      ELSE dt_seconds
    END AS held_seconds

)
SELECT
  equipment_id,

    WHEN cooling_sp IS NOT NULL AND heating_sp IS NOT NULL

    THEN held_seconds ELSE 0.0

  SUM(held_seconds) / 3600.0 AS covered_hours,

    WHEN cooling_sp IS NOT NULL AND heating_sp IS NOT NULL
     AND cooling_sp - heating_sp < 1
    THEN held_seconds ELSE 0.0
  END) / NULLIF(SUM(held_seconds), 0.0) AS fault_pct

WITH modes AS (
  SELECT
    equipment_id,
    timestamp_utc,
    CASE
      WHEN clg_valve_pct IS NOT NULL AND clg_valve_pct > 0.1 THEN -1
      WHEN htg_valve_pct IS NOT NULL AND htg_valve_pct > 0.1 THEN 1
      ELSE 0
    END AS mode
  FROM history
),
active_modes AS (
  SELECT equipment_id, timestamp_utc, mode
  FROM modes
  WHERE mode <> 0
),
changes AS (
  SELECT
    equipment_id,
    timestamp_utc,
    mode,
    CASE
      WHEN LAG(mode) OVER (PARTITION BY equipment_id ORDER BY timestamp_utc) IS NOT NULL
       AND mode <> LAG(mode) OVER (PARTITION BY equipment_id ORDER BY timestamp_utc)
      THEN 1 ELSE 0
    END AS changed,
    ((
      LEAD(timestamp_utc) OVER (PARTITION BY equipment_id ORDER BY timestamp_utc)
      - timestamp_utc
    )) AS dt_seconds
  FROM active_modes
),
cumulative AS (
  SELECT
    equipment_id,
    SUM(changed) OVER (
      PARTITION BY equipment_id ORDER BY timestamp_utc ROWS UNBOUNDED PRECEDING
    ) AS change_count,
    CASE
      WHEN dt_seconds IS NULL OR dt_seconds <= 0.0 OR dt_seconds > (1 * 3600.0)
      THEN 0.0
      ELSE dt_seconds
    END AS held_seconds
  FROM changes
)
SELECT
  equipment_id,
  SUM(CASE WHEN change_count >= 4 THEN held_seconds ELSE 0.0 END) / 3600.0 AS fault_hours,
  SUM(held_seconds) / 3600.0 AS covered_hours,
  100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN change_count >= 4 THEN held_seconds ELSE 0.0 END)
    / NULLIF(SUM(held_seconds), 0.0) AS fault_pct
FROM cumulative
GROUP BY equipment_id;

UTIL-MONTHLY.sql:
WITH bas_raw AS (
  SELECT
    timestamp_utc,
    kwh,
    electric_kw,
    ((
      LEAD(timestamp_utc) OVER (ORDER BY timestamp_utc) - timestamp_utc
    )) AS dt_seconds
  FROM history
  WHERE kwh IS NOT NULL OR electric_kw IS NOT NULL
),
bas_monthly AS (
  SELECT
    strftime('%Y-%m', timestamp_utc, 'unixepoch') AS billing_period,
    SUM(
      COALESCE(
        CAST(kwh AS REAL),
        CASE
          WHEN dt_seconds > 0.0 AND dt_seconds <= (1 * 3600.0)
          THEN CAST(electric_kw AS REAL) * dt_seconds / 3600.0
          ELSE 0.0
        END,
        0.0
      )
    ) AS bas_kwh
  FROM bas_raw
  GROUP BY 1
),
util AS (
  SELECT
    billing_period,
    CAST(kwh AS REAL) AS util_kwh
  FROM utility_monthly
  WHERE kwh IS NOT NULL
),
joined AS (
  SELECT
    u.billing_period,
    u.util_kwh,
    COALESCE(b.bas_kwh, 0.0) AS bas_kwh,
    CASE
      WHEN u.util_kwh IS NULL OR u.util_kwh <= 0 THEN 0
      WHEN ABS(COALESCE(b.bas_kwh, 0.0) - u.util_kwh) / u.util_kwh * 100.0 > 10
      THEN 1
      ELSE 0
    END AS raw_fault
  FROM util u
  LEFT JOIN bas_monthly b ON b.billing_period = u.billing_period
)
SELECT
  '__UTIL_MONTHLY__' AS equipment_id,
  CAST(SUM(raw_fault) AS REAL) * 720.0 AS fault_hours,
  NULL AS covered_hours,
  NULL AS fault_pct
FROM joined;

WITH bas_raw AS (
  SELECT
    timestamp_utc,
    kwh,
    electric_kw,
    ((
      LEAD(timestamp_utc) OVER (ORDER BY timestamp_utc) - timestamp_utc
    )) AS dt_seconds
  FROM history
  WHERE kwh IS NOT NULL OR electric_kw IS NOT NULL
),
bas AS (
  SELECT
    timestamp_utc,
    COALESCE(
      CAST(kwh AS REAL),
      CASE
        WHEN dt_seconds > 0.0 AND dt_seconds <= (1 * 3600.0)
        THEN CAST(electric_kw AS REAL) * dt_seconds / 3600.0
        ELSE 0.0
      END
    ) AS bas_kwh
  FROM bas_raw
),
util AS (
  SELECT
    timestamp_utc,
    CAST(kwh AS REAL) AS util_kwh
  FROM utility_interval
  WHERE kwh IS NOT NULL
),
joined AS (
  SELECT
    b.timestamp_utc,
    ABS(COALESCE(b.bas_kwh, 0.0) - COALESCE(u.util_kwh, 0.0)) AS abs_err
  FROM bas b
  INNER JOIN util u ON b.timestamp_utc = u.timestamp_utc
),
agg AS (
  SELECT
  AVG(abs_err) AS mae
  FROM joined
)
SELECT
  '__UTIL_INTERVAL__' AS equipment_id,
  CASE
    WHEN (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM util) = 0 THEN 0.0
    WHEN mae > 5 THEN 720.0
    ELSE 0.0
  END AS fault_hours,
  NULL AS covered_hours,
  NULL AS fault_pct
FROM agg;

WITH rp AS (
  SELECT equipment_id,
    CASE WHEN 1 >= 0.5 AND COUNT(run_proof) = 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS no_run_proof
  FROM history
  GROUP BY equipment_id
),
h AS (
  SELECT
    run_proof,
    equipment_id,
    timestamp_utc,
    COALESCE(htg_valve_pct, reheat_valve_pct) AS htg,
    clg_valve_pct AS clg,
    htg_valve_pct,
    reheat_valve_pct,
    zone_flow,
    CASE
      WHEN fan_status IS NOT NULL THEN CASE WHEN fan_status > 0.05 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END
      WHEN fan_cmd IS NOT NULL THEN CASE WHEN fan_cmd > 0.01 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END
      ELSE 1
    END AS fan_on,
    CASE
      WHEN heating_coil_leaving_temp IS NOT NULL AND heating_coil_entering_temp IS NOT NULL THEN heating_coil_leaving_temp - heating_coil_entering_temp
      WHEN sat IS NOT NULL AND mat IS NOT NULL THEN sat - mat
      WHEN vav_discharge_t IS NOT NULL AND vav_inlet_t IS NOT NULL THEN vav_discharge_t - vav_inlet_t
      WHEN sat IS NOT NULL AND zone_t IS NOT NULL THEN sat - zone_t
      ELSE NULL
    END AS heat_rise,
    CASE
      WHEN cooling_coil_leaving_temp IS NOT NULL AND cooling_coil_entering_temp IS NOT NULL THEN cooling_coil_entering_temp - cooling_coil_leaving_temp
      WHEN sat IS NOT NULL AND mat IS NOT NULL THEN mat - sat
      WHEN vav_discharge_t IS NOT NULL AND vav_inlet_t IS NOT NULL THEN vav_inlet_t - vav_discharge_t
      WHEN sat IS NOT NULL AND zone_t IS NOT NULL THEN zone_t - sat
      ELSE NULL
    END AS cool_drop
  FROM history
),
pairs AS (
  SELECT equipment_id,
    CASE WHEN COUNT(htg) + COUNT(clg) = 0 OR COUNT(heat_rise) + COUNT(cool_drop) = 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS no_pair,
    CASE WHEN COUNT(htg) + COUNT(clg) = 0 THEN 'no_coil_valve'
         WHEN COUNT(heat_rise) + COUNT(cool_drop) = 0 THEN 'no_temperature_pair'
         ELSE 'assessed' END AS assessment
  FROM h
  GROUP BY equipment_id
),
base AS (
  SELECT
    equipment_id,
    timestamp_utc,
    CAST(round(CASE
      WHEN 1 >= 0.5 AND COALESCE(run_proof, 0) <= 0.05 THEN 0
      WHEN COALESCE(fan_on, 0) = 0 THEN 0
      WHEN zone_flow IS NOT NULL AND zone_flow <= 11.798675 THEN 0
      WHEN htg IS NOT NULL AND htg >= 0.8 AND (clg IS NULL OR clg <= 0.05)
       AND heat_rise IS NOT NULL AND heat_rise < 3 THEN 1
      WHEN clg IS NOT NULL AND clg >= 0.8
       AND (htg_valve_pct IS NULL OR htg_valve_pct <= 0.05)
       AND (reheat_valve_pct IS NULL OR reheat_valve_pct <= 0.05)
       AND cool_drop IS NOT NULL AND cool_drop < 3 THEN 1
      ELSE 0
    END) AS INTEGER) AS raw_fault
  FROM h
),
elapsed_hold AS (
  SELECT
    stepped.*,
    CASE
      WHEN stepped.dt_seconds IS NULL
        OR stepped.dt_seconds <= 0.0
        OR stepped.dt_seconds > (1 * 3600.0)
      THEN 0.0
      ELSE stepped.dt_seconds
    END AS held_seconds,
    CASE
      WHEN stepped.dt_seconds > (1 * 3600.0) THEN 1
      ELSE 0
    END AS gap_after
  FROM (
    SELECT
      src.*,
      ((
        LEAD(src.timestamp_utc) OVER (
          PARTITION BY src.equipment_id ORDER BY src.timestamp_utc
        ) - src.timestamp_utc
      )) AS dt_seconds
    FROM base src
  ) stepped
),
lagged AS (
  SELECT
    *,
    CASE
      WHEN raw_fault = LAG(raw_fault) OVER (PARTITION BY equipment_id ORDER BY timestamp_utc)
       AND COALESCE(LAG(gap_after) OVER (PARTITION BY equipment_id ORDER BY timestamp_utc), 0) = 0
      THEN 0 ELSE 1
    END AS is_new_streak
  FROM elapsed_hold
),
grp AS (
  SELECT
    *,
    SUM(is_new_streak)
      OVER (PARTITION BY equipment_id ORDER BY timestamp_utc ROWS UNBOUNDED PRECEDING) AS streak_id
  FROM lagged
),
ranked AS (
  SELECT
    *,
    SUM(held_seconds) OVER (
      PARTITION BY equipment_id, streak_id ORDER BY timestamp_utc
      ROWS UNBOUNDED PRECEDING
    ) AS streak_elapsed
  FROM grp
),
final AS (
  SELECT
    equipment_id,
    held_seconds,
    CASE WHEN raw_fault = 1 AND streak_elapsed >= 900 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS confirmed
  FROM ranked
)
SELECT
  equipment_id,
  CASE WHEN (SELECT rpx.no_run_proof FROM rp rpx WHERE rpx.equipment_id = final.equipment_id) = 1
         OR (SELECT px.no_pair FROM pairs px WHERE px.equipment_id = final.equipment_id) = 1 THEN NULL
       ELSE SUM(CASE WHEN confirmed = 1 THEN held_seconds ELSE 0.0 END) / 3600.0 END AS fault_hours,
  CASE WHEN (SELECT rpx.no_run_proof FROM rp rpx WHERE rpx.equipment_id = final.equipment_id) = 1
         OR (SELECT px.no_pair FROM pairs px WHERE px.equipment_id = final.equipment_id) = 1 THEN 0.0
       ELSE SUM(held_seconds) / 3600.0 END AS covered_hours,
  CASE WHEN (SELECT rpx.no_run_proof FROM rp rpx WHERE rpx.equipment_id = final.equipment_id) = 1
         OR (SELECT px.no_pair FROM pairs px WHERE px.equipment_id = final.equipment_id) = 1 THEN NULL
       ELSE 100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN confirmed = 1 THEN held_seconds ELSE 0.0 END) / NULLIF(SUM(held_seconds), 0.0) END AS fault_pct,
  (SELECT px.assessment FROM pairs px WHERE px.equipment_id = final.equipment_id) AS assessment
FROM final
GROUP BY equipment_id;
